correctness.rationale: Consecutive triangle area is (1/2)ell_i ell_(i+1) sin(2pi/n); positive sides force ell_(i+2)=ell_i. Odd n gives all equal lengths; for even n the alternating edge directions independently sum to zero so a,b>0 polygons close and are strictly convex. Complex Fourier modes z^i and (-z)^i yield area n/16[cot(pi/n)(a+b)^2-tan(pi/n)(a-b)^2]; mixed cross terms sum to zero. Subtract regular area to obtain deficit n/16 tan(pi/n)(a-b)^2. Opposite edges e_(i+n/2)=-e_i iff n divisible by four or a=b. Independent direct shoelace/triangle checks for sample n,a,b corroborated; symbolic proof covers all n.
residual_risks: Strict convexity and n>=5; other equal-area polygons not classified.
